entries.exactSourceEnglish: A yellow leaf is not automatically an insect. It can be water, nutrition, or root damage. Find out which before you act.

entries.exactSourceEnglish: One. Observe. Look at the damage pattern, the underside of the leaf, the stem, and the plants nearby.

entries.exactSourceEnglish: Two. Check for stress. Soil moisture, roots, spacing, nutrition, drainage.
